brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir shared an artificial intelligence-generated video that mocks the devastation in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The post comes amid ongoing destruction in the territory from Israel's military operations.

Ben-Gvir's use of AI-generated content to ridicule Gaza's situation marks an escalation in inflammatory rhetoric from senior Israeli officials regarding the conflict and its humanitarian toll.
dek: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has posted an AI-generated video mocking the devastation in Gaza.
title: Ben-Gvir posts AI video mocking Gaza destruction
